verdict.rationale: LiteLLM proxy docs show request-level tracing via unique call_id, cost/spend tracking by key/user/team, and integration with logging providers (Langfuse, DataDog, OpenTelemetry, etc.) that would surface latency and token data, but no evidence pack item explicitly confirms a built-in dashboard view showing latency + token counts + cost together per logged request. Missing for 10: direct documentation/screenshot of the admin UI request log showing latency and token counts alongside cost, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific inspection workflow.
